blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Vitamatic Vitamin D3 is a very important nutrient for overall healthy muscle function, increases calcium absorption for stronger bones, teeth, and immune support.
The vast majority of individuals are deficient in Vitamin D, a life-sustaining vitamin.
All the benefits of vitamin D without the risk of unprotected exposure to UVB rays. Safe and natural way to get this much-needed vitamin.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: As a dietary supplement, take 1 capsule once a week with 8 to 12 oz of water or as directed by your healthcare provider.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Cellulose (vegetable capsule), rice flour, magnesium stearate, silicon dioxide.
Free of sugar, yeast, wheat, egg, artificial colors, flavors. and preservatives.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Consult with your healthcare provider if you are pregnant, nursing, taking any medications, or planning any medical procedures. Stop use immediately and consult your healthcare provider if you experience any adverse effects. Do not use it if the safety seal is broken or missing. Keep out of the reach of children. Store in a cool and dry place. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Food supplements should not be used as a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and healthy lifestyle.
